meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你管理 Git 仓库：自动将代码更改拆成多个有意义的提交，帮你重写提交历史（如合并、调整顺序），还能搜索某行代码是谁在何时写的。
howto.when: 当你说“提交代码”“合并提交”“重写历史”“查找谁写的”等与 Git 相关的请求时触发。

say.text: 帮我提交这些代码变更，拆成合适的提交。
say.note: Claude 会分析文件并分组提交。

say.text: 把最近三次提交合并成一个。
say.note: Claude 会执行 squash 操作。

say.text: 查找这个函数是谁引入的。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a Git expert: it automatically splits code changes into multiple atomic commits, rewrites history (rebase/squash), and searches for when/where specific code was introduced.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Git operations like 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', or 'find the commit that'.

say_en.text: Commit these changes, splitting them properly.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes files and groups commits.

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one.

say_en.note: Claude uses git blame or log -S.
